about.greeting: Hi there! Glad to see you here.
about.bio: Hello! I am Mohd Kashif, a Software Engineer at Dhira Software Labs (promoted from Full-Stack Intern) and Computer Science graduate from Cambridge Institute of Technology (8.66 CGPA / 86.6%). I specialize in React 19, TypeScript, React Flow, Node.js, Express, Java (DSA), and SQL / MongoDB. I have engineered platforms like CBSE Aakalan (CBA Platform), Stay Ease Rental Platform, and Mega-Vlog. Additionally, I am a published author on GeeksforGeeks with 61,000+ readers and proficient in AI-assisted productivity tools like ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot.
about.paragraph: I create high-performance, accessible, and responsive enterprise web architectures with modern design systems and intuitive user experiences.
